passages.text: Find the tiny egg on the leaf. What shape is the egg?
Explore the moon. Is its shape round or square?
Look at the big sun. Name one color you can see in it.
Find the apple. Apple begins with A. Can you say the letter A?
Count the two pears. Pear begins with P. Can you say the letter P?
Find the purple plums. How many plums are there?
Find the red strawberries. Count them slowly. How many are there?
Find the oranges. Count them from left to right. How many are there?
Explore the green leaf. Leaf begins with L. Can you say the letter L?
Explore the butterfly wings. Butterfly begins with B. Can you say the letter B?
